          value={colorX}

        </TextField>
        <TextField
          select

          onChange={(event) =>

          }

          <MenuItem value="None">None</MenuItem>
          <MenuItem value="piecewise">piecewise</MenuItem>

        </TextField>

        height={300}
        grid={{ horizontal: true }}
        series={series}
        yAxis={[
          {
            colorMap:
              (colorY === 'continuous' && {
                type: 'continuous',
                min: -10,

              }) ||
              (colorY === 'piecewise' && {
                type: 'piecewise',
                thresholds: [0],
                colors: ['red', 'green'],

                `    }`,

            : []),

                `      type: 'piecewise',`,

                `    }`,
                '  }]}',
              ]
            : []),

          ...(colorY === 'continuous'
            ? [
                '  yAxis={[{',
                `    colorMap: {`,
                `      type: 'continuous',`,
                `      min: -10,`,
                `      max: 10,`,
                `      color: ['red', 'green'],`,
                `    }`,
                '  }]}',
              ]
            : []),
          ...(colorY === 'piecewise'
            ? [
                '  yAxis={[{',
                `    colorMap: {`,
                `      type: 'piecewise',`,
                `      thresholds: [0],`,
                `      colors: ['red', 'green'],`,
                `    }`,
                '  }]}',
              ]
            : []),
          `/>`,
        ].join('\n')}
        language="jsx"
        copyButtonHidden
      />
    </Stack>
  );
}

export function withCountryCodeAsName(
  geoData: ExtendedFeatureCollection,
): ExtendedFeatureCollection {
  const nameToCode = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(countryData).map(([code, { worldAtlasName }]) => [worldAtlasName, code]),
  );

  // Seems like our world in data does not distinguish Somalia and Somaliland, but GeoJSON does.
  nameToCode.Somaliland = 'SOM';

  return {
    ...geoData,
    features: geoData.features.map((feature: ExtendedFeature) => {
      const name = feature.properties?.name;
      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
        return feature;
      }
      return {
        ...feature,
        properties: {
          ...feature.properties,
          name: code,
        },
      };
    }),
  };
}

export function withCountryCodeAsName(geoData) {
  const nameToCode = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(countryData).map(([code, { worldAtlasName }]) => [
      worldAtlasName,
      code,
    ]),
  );

  // Seems like our world in data does not distinguish Somalia and Somaliland, but GeoJSON does.
  nameToCode.Somaliland = 'SOM';

  return {
    ...geoData,
    features: geoData.features.map((feature) => {
      const name = feature.properties?.name;
      const code = nameToCode[name];
      if (code === undefined) {
        return feature;
      }
      return {
        ...feature,
        properties: {
          ...feature.properties,
          name: code,
        },
      };
    }),
  };
}
